description: Everything tracked for 1-100 products: details, categories, images, dimensions, fees, statistics, price and sales-rank history, buy box, live offers, stock, rating history. Price follows data cost (from ~$0.005; offers/buybox/rating add cost). Use history=false for current data only.

buybox.description: Buy box price/winner history and stats (+cost)

days.description: Limit history to last N days

history.description: Include price/rank history (default false here to keep responses small)

series.description: History series, comma-separated, or "all". Default BUY_BOX_SHIPPING,AMAZON,NEW,SALES_RANK

update.description: Refresh data older than N hours; 0 = force live refresh (+cost)

name: get_products
title: Full Amazon product data
